message.content:
This editorial illustration features three men in front of grey metal bank vaults. In the center, a large man with squinted eyes and a grimace wears a tan long-sleeved shirt and trousers. He holds a brass water faucet mounted on a vault door. A stream of green banknotes flows from the faucet into a large dark brown sack held at his waist. The sack has a white label reading "KOPERASI MERAH PUTIH".

Behind him, two other men peer over his shoulders. The man on the left has short dark hair and a neutral expression, while the man on the right wears glasses, a blue collared shirt, and has grey hair and a goatee. 

Large red letters spell "TEMPO" at the top. To its left, "Lokalisasi Penyidikan Pagar Laut H.68" is printed; to its right is "Gula-gula Pengakuan Hutan Adat H.92". Bold black text reads "KOPER-KOPERASI MERAH PUTIH". A smaller text block on the left describes a plan for 80,000 cooperatives valued at Rp 400 trillion. The bottom right includes the date "28 APRIL-4 MEI 2025," price "RP 60.000," and a barcode.
